desc:
🤖 WELCOME TO DEAD PLANET ROBOT! 🌍

You crash-land on a dead planet as nothing more than a robot head!

🔩*Find parts. Build your mech. Become a legend!

🏟️ NEW: PvP Arena! 1v1, 2v2 and Free For All. Climb the weekly leaderboard and win the ARENA KING aura.

⚙️ Explore a dangerous world and build your own robot, piece by piece!

⚔️ Fight deadly robots, challenge powerful ELITES, and collect rare MECH PARTS!

💥 Destroy enemy limbs and unleash devastating attacks!

🔥 Discover transforming weapons, special abilities, and legendary mech families!

💀 Defeat 7 Giant Titans and bring their trophies home!

🏠 Upgrade your mech and customize your own hangar!

🤝 Team up with friends, explore dangerous zones, and battle other players!

🌋 Enter the HELL DIMENSION and face terrifying bosses!

💀 Hunt 7 giant TITANS and the demon samurai ONI.

👑 Unlock mythical mechs: WUKONG, EXCALIBUR, and ONI.

❓ Can you survive the DEAD PLANET and build the ULTIMATE MECH?
